name: Praise Victor Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Praise Victor Industrial Co., Ltd. designs, produces, and trades in polyurethanes (PU) materials. It provides chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) pads; CMP parts, such as membranes, pedestal films, support films, backing films, hub pads, rollers, and other products used in semiconductor and optoelectronic industries; PU gels, which is used for insoles, mouse pads, and various seat cushions; foam series products for safety balls, shoe materials, medical care equipment, and furniture materials; and safety-ball products, softsole, cupsole, golf insole, basketball insole, and fitnesssole for health products.
